_doc: namecheck.py warnings that were looked at and kept. fr_sync and translit entries pin the names, so a later change on either side warns again. Keys: kind:CONSTANT (fr_sync, translit) and the English name (dupes).

species:SPECIES_EXEGGUTOR.why: names follow FireRed (DECISIONS Q140), but FireRed's spelling does not fit: the Alolan form must be the base name + -א (Q129), and אקזגקיוטור-א is 52 px in the 50 px party and Pokédex lists and the 48 px healthbox (English 44 px)

move:MOVE_SLASH.why: FireRed's חיתוך is already MOVE_CUT in H&S (FireRed has the same duplicate), and two moves cannot share a name; שיסוף also matches NIGHT SLASH שיסוף לילי and AIR SLASH שיסוף אוויר (DECISIONS Q140)

item:ITEM_CHESTO_BERRY.why: a slip in FireRed: the English CHESTO has no R, and FireRed's צ'סטרו adds one (DECISIONS K6, Q140)

item:ITEM_IAPAPA_BERRY.why: the berry tag holds 6 bytes, so the stem is יאפאפה in both trees (FireRed src/berry.c too); H&S writes the bag name with the tag's stem so the two match (DECISIONS K6); FireRed's bag name differs from its own tag (Q140)

item:ITEM_POKEBLOCK_CASE.why: FireRed writes the {POKEBLOCK} token first for its own renderer; H&S keeps the reading order (STYLE §5, DECISIONS Q140)

trainer_class:TRAINER_CLASS_ELITE_FOUR.why: FireRed's full spelling עילית is 13 bytes; a trainer class name holds 12 (include/data.h u8 name[13]); FireRed widened its array for it, which in H&S is an engine change (DECISIONS Q140)

move:MOVE_PSYCHO_BOOST.why: Psychic is על-חושי in every name (DECISIONS Q139), the PSYCHO moves too; FireRed renamed its type and its PSYCHIC move but left this name on the old word

species:SPECIES_MEOWTH_ALOLA.why: MEOWTH is מיאו (FireRed); the TH is not pronounced

species:SPECIES_MEOWTH_GALAR.why: MEOWTH is מיאו (FireRed); the TH is not pronounced

species:SPECIES_FARFETCHD_GALAR.why: -TCH'D is ג'ד as in FireRed's FARFETCH'D

species:SPECIES_SIRFETCHD.why: -TCH'D is ג'ד as in FireRed's FARFETCH'D

species:SPECIES_PORYGON_Z.why: the Latin Z is kept on purpose (the example in the transliteration rules)

species:SPECIES_MAUSHOLD_THREE.why: S and H are two sounds (maus-hold)

species:SPECIES_MAUSHOLD_FOUR.why: S and H are two sounds (maus-hold)
